mapper.sql: agent_id, agent_code, agent_name, category_code, icon_code, cover_url, provider_id, provider_name, summary, description, price_text, price_min, price_max, cert_level, rating, deploy_count, delivery_cycle, service_mode, recommend_flag, hot_score, sort_no, publish_status, published_at, slug, version_no, ext_json, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.select: select from biz_agent where agent_id = #{agentId} and del_flag = '0'
select from biz_agent where agent_id = #{agentId} and publish_status = '1' and del_flag = '0'

select item_id, agent_id, item_type, title, subtitle, value_text, content, icon_code, link_url, sort_no, status, ext_json, create_time, update_time from biz_agent_detail_item where agent_id = #{agentId} and status = '0' order by item_type asc, sort_no asc, item_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_agent ( agent_code, agent_name, category_code, icon_code, cover_url, provider_id, provider_name, summary, description, price_text, price_min, price_max, cert_level, rating, deploy_count, delivery_cycle, service_mode, recommend_flag, hot_score, sort_no, publish_status, published_at, slug, version_no, ext_json, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{agentCode}, #{agentName}, #{categoryCode}, #{iconCode}, #{coverUrl}, #{providerId}, #{providerName}, #{summary}, #{description}, #{priceText}, #{priceMin}, #{priceMax}, #{certLevel}, #{rating}, #{deployCount}, #{deliveryCycle}, #{serviceMode}, #{recommendFlag}, #{hotScore}, #{sortNo}, #{publishStatus}, #{publishedAt}, #{slug}, #{versionNo}, #{extJson}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )

insert into biz_agent_detail_item (agent_id, item_type, title, subtitle, value_text, content, icon_code, link_url, sort_no, status, ext_json, create_time) values
(#{item.agentId}, #{item.itemType}, #{item.title}, #{item.subtitle}, #{item.valueText}, #{item.content}, #{item.iconCode}, #{item.linkUrl}, #{item.sortNo}, #{item.status}, #{item.extJson}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update biz_agent_detail_item set title = #{title}, value_text = #{valueText}, content = #{content}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where item_id = #{itemId} and agent_id = #{agentId} and item_type = 'CASE'
